bibl.title: Frammenti mitografici latini provenienti dall'Egitto.
bibl.seg: Felicia Tafuri, Frammenti mitografici latini provenienti dall'Egitto.
bibl.note: Provides a new analysis of four latin fragments preserved on the verso of P. Gen. Inv. Lat. 7 (= MP3 2994; LDAB 5034; 2nd century AD). Rather than an inventory of works of art linked to P. Gen. Inv. Lat. 5 (= MP3 2995; LDAB 5034), they contain two tets of mythographic content concerning Roman divinities and heroes, Egyptian mythology, and religious mysteries of Persephon, mentioned together with divinities and demigods traditionally linked to the underworld.
